headline: Gabriel India acquires stake in HL Klemove India Private Limited
sum: Gabriel India announced an acquisition of stake in HL Klemove India Private Limited, signalling expansion in automotive components and suspension systems.
implication: Vertical or horizontal consolidation in the Indian automotive aftermarket and OEM supply chain; review material subsidiary reporting under SEBI Listing Rules and CCI merger thresholds.
detail: Gabriel India Limited, a publicly listed automotive component manufacturer, disclosed a stake acquisition in HL Klemove India Private Limited. HL Klemove is a joint venture entity in the automotive suspension and damping systems segment. The disclosure was filed with the NSE on 21 August 2026 as a regulatory update. No consideration amount or shareholding percentage was disclosed in the headline announcement; further details may be contained in the full regulatory filing or subsequent board disclosures.
